mechanism: Affordability regime changes demand and cash quality
dependent_observables: Traffic comparable sales mix markdowns inventory payables support and cash after property
principal_confound_controls: Store changes promotions tariffs/refunds vendor terms acquisitions shrink freight attached-service mix
promotion_requirement: Repeated aligned fiscal periods with lead/lag evidence and measured company-specific confounds
filing_based_breaker: Stable demand with deteriorating cash quality or post-support deterioration

mechanism: Rate silver-price and delivery regimes change stream return
dependent_observables: BHP-only payable ounces settlement price receipt cash delivery timing financing burden and owner return
principal_confound_controls: Reserve/resource basis payability assay quotation period tax debt allocation counterparty and corporate funding
promotion_requirement: BHP-only settlement and receipt evidence plus reserve-backed multi-period delivery and allocated after-tax financed return
filing_based_breaker: Delivered or settled metal below quantity price or timing required to recover upfront payment and financing

mechanism: Macro and liquidity regimes change spread and upstream common cash
dependent_observables: Asset yield cost of funds spread credit losses capital availability distributions and AGM receipt
principal_confound_controls: Asset mix hedges marks reinsurance policyholder flows regulatory capital preferred claims legal restrictions
promotion_requirement: Period-matched liability and spread data plus realized route cash regulatory constraints and repeated observations
filing_based_breaker: Spread compression credit loss or regulated restriction blocks predicted common-owner conversion
